Flat opening + first session of a series = trending probability rises; avoid fresh selling in the first 45 minutes
quote: Do not sell options in the first 45 minutes on the first trading session.

summary: Global sentiment strong (S&P ~6,000; Korea post-election +2.6%) but India held back by Bank Nifty rejig selling (12 to 14 stocks, top lenders' weights cut). VIX collapsed 5% in minutes, then again next day. RBI policy tomorrow - expected 50bp cut, possible Bank Nifty breakout trigger.

events.claim: South Korea held elections and the opposition leader won (early June 2025), Kospi shot up ~2.6%

RBI policy (June 6, 2025) widely expected to cut rates by 50 basis points

lessons: Index-construction changes create mechanical, predictable selling in capped heavyweights - trade the rebalance, not the news

lessons: Good news after a big run invites profit booking - strength near resistance is for trimming, not chasing
Crude moves hit India sentimentally (no pass-through), hurting autos more than the index math suggests
quote: When there is a good news like 50 basis points rate cut, market goes higher, then two three days profit booking comes.
